intro: Meet the Rhino Advanced V2 Steel Digital Home Locker, the the perfect fusion of style and security. Crafting security with innovation and truct for many generations.

features.title: Autolock Keypad Freeze Function
features.text: Automatic sensor freeze function that keeps your valuables safe by preventing unauthorised access after 4 consecutive wrong password entries.

features.title: Digital Locking Mechanism
features.text: The lock allows secure access with a customizable 4–6 digit password, giving you flexibility and security tailored to your preference. The system's non-volatile memory ensures reliable password storage, even during power outages.

features.title: External USB Charging Support
features.text: With the Home Locker's external USB charging port, you'll never have to worry about running out of battery when you need it most.

features.title: Ultimate Security with 3 Way Solid Steel Shooting Bolts
features.text: Our locker is equipped with 3-way solid steel shooting bolts for enhanced protection. These heavy-duty bolts reinforce the safe door, ensuring your valuables are secured with maximum strength.

features.title: Emergency Mechanical Override
features.text: In the event of low battery and forgotten password the emergency mechanical override key ensures your valuables are always within reach with our reliable backup access solution.

features.title: Mounting & Grouting
features.text: Designed for ultimate protection,this feature allows you to securely mount or grout the safe to walls, floors, or shelves using robust anchor bolts. By firmly fastening the locker in place, it becomes significantly more resistant to tampering or unauthorized removal, providing an extra layer of security.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
